description: Build a non-invasive layered translation evidence, confidence, analysis, visualization, publication and upstream-handoff platform.
known_blockers: Upstream does not accept AI-generated translations as authoritative translation contributions.
No upstream write, issue, project, PR or publication action is authorized.
Human-mediated provenance is incomplete or heterogeneous for some translation records.
External terminology licences, redistribution rules and language-community use constraints remain source-specific.
Empirical calibration data and outcome labels do not yet exist for the proposed confidence model.
A public Hugging Face Space must not expose restricted source text, private evaluation data or unapproved candidate translations.
The final arXiv and upstream handoff require completed analyses, reproducible artifacts, disclosure, maintainer approval and current-session external-write authority.
expected_blockers: Independent human-mediated evidence may be sparse or share hidden upstream lineages.
Confidence calibration may be unstable for low-resource languages and rare HPO branches.
Model pretraining contamination cannot be fully excluded.
Interactive network visualization may require aggregation to remain performant and payload-safe.
Upstream maintainers may prefer only minimal translation changes and no research-platform code.
blocker_owner: fork maintainer with source-rights, language-community, ethics/privacy, upstream and publication authorities
fallback_path: Remain a local metadata-only research overlay; publish no dashboard, preprint, issue, project or upstream patch until every applicable gate closes.

restricted_payload_policy.commit_policy: Commit schemas, source identifiers, hashes, synthetic fixtures, permitted open artifacts, aggregate metrics and payload-safe receipts only.

fail_fast_probe.scope: one synthetic HPO concept-language record with a simulated human baseline, two lineage groups, one structural constraint, one AI candidate, one contradiction and one unavailable source
success_criteria: every atom has immutable provenance and rights state
confidence category and rationale are deterministic
passing and expected-failure tests behave deterministically

excluded_until_policy_allows: live GitHub project or issue mutations

evidence_score_policy.promotion_rule: No confidence category or probability authorizes upstream promotion.
